11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager wakes from a vivid dream in which a friend sold their sandals to buy a purple chicken.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wakes from an extraordinarily vivid dream in which (friend) stole (subject.his/her) favorite sandals, sold them to a passing trader, and used the proceeds to purchase a magnificent purple chicken. (subject) knows perfectly well that none of this happened. Unfortunately, (subject.he/she) is still a little annoyed.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "A purple chicken?" (friend) asks. "Why purple?" (subject) doesn't know. (friend) considers this. "I would have bought a blue one." Somehow this makes (subject) even more annoyed. Neither can stop laughing.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: By lunchtime (subject) has forgotten most of the dream. Then (friend) walks past carrying a pair of sandals. (subject) stares suspiciously. (friend) has absolutely no idea why.
